Let \(A=(t^2,t)\), \(B=(s^2,-s)\) with \(t,s>0\). From the valid case \(ts=2\).

Areas:
\[
[\triangle ABO]=\frac12\left(t^2s+ts^2\right)=\frac12(2t+2s)=t+s.
\]
\[
[\triangle AFO]=\frac12\left|t^2\cdot 0-t\cdot \frac14\right|=\frac t8.
\]
Thus total area:
\[
S=t+s+\frac t8=\frac98 t+s.
\]
Using \(ts=2\), so \(s=\frac2t\):
\[
S=\frac98 t+\frac2t.
\]
By AM-GM,
\[
\frac98 t+\frac2t \ge 2\sqrt{\frac98\cdot 2}=2\sqrt{\frac94}=3.
\]
Equality at \(t=\frac43\), \(s=\frac32\).

\[
\boxed{3}
\]
